featured_activities: What Have You Learned So Far?

source_atoms.fact: The book is an official Grade XI English textbook titled Bahasa Inggris: English for Change untuk SMA/MA Kelas XI.
The book states that it is developed with reference to Kurikulum Merdeka and may be modified, used as an example, or used as a reference according to learner characteristics, potential, and needs.
The book targets communicative competence and states that Grade XI English learning targets B1 CEFR level.
Learning activities use Genre-Based Approach with five stages: BKoF, MoT, JCoT, ICoT, and LRTs.
Each unit consists of six lessons aligned to listening, speaking, reading, viewing, writing, and presenting, followed by reflection.

units.title: Digital Literacies and My Identities
units.essential_question: How do digital literacies help shape my future identities?
units.topic: Digital Literacies for Youth's Identity Construction

skills.listening: Correctly categorize expressions for stating opinions, agreeing, and disagreeing in a spoken transactional conversation.
skills.speaking: Use suitable expressions for stating opinions, agreeing, and disagreeing in a spoken transactional conversation with peers.
skills.reading: Identify an author's/content creator's purpose and make evidence-based inferences to comprehend implicit information in multimodal text.
skills.viewing: Comprehend implicit information and infer meaning from multimodal text such as social media posts.
skills.writing: Formulate subject questions for an interactive and engaging social media caption and produce an appropriate social media post.
skills.presenting: Talk about the process of creating/posting a social media post using transitional words and a graphic organizer.

learning_objectives: categorize opinion, agreement, and disagreement expressions in spoken transactional conversation
use opinion, agreement, and disagreement expressions appropriately
identify author/content creator purpose
make evidence-based inferences about implicit information
formulate subject questions
write an interactive and engaging social media caption/post
use transitional words to show sequence
present the process of producing a social media post

units.title: Love Your Environment

skills.viewing: Identify core and specific information in descriptive texts or visual materials.
skills.writing: Write a descriptive text about a place using five senses, adjective phrases, appropriate grammar, and punctuation.
skills.presenting: Present a digital or non-digital poster/description of an interesting or clean place.

identify core and specific information
